original_test_intent: Verify that removing one designated member from an approved isolated NVMe RAID1 produces the documented RAID-fail LED plus correct degraded/member-failed controller and management evidence.
original_method: After destructive approval, build a healthy RAID1 from two disposable mapped drives, have a qualified operator unplug only the designated member, and correlate physical LED evidence with complete controller, OS, BMC and health state while preserving a separate recovery boundary.
manual_activity: User approves disposable members, array/fault and recovery boundaries; qualified operator removes the exact member and records the LED; agent monitors only and does not start recovery.
required_inputs: Two disposable NVMe stable IDs, slots and controller mapping
RAID1 creation settings and RAID-fail LED state/timing specification
Supported hot-remove procedure and qualified operator
Backup/OOB, abort thresholds and degraded-state duration
safety_requirements: Exclude boot, production, management and unknown drives and verify both serials before creation
Start from healthy initialized RAID1 with no background task
Remove only one exact supported member and preserve logs
Stop on wrong member, uncontrolled rebuild, data/filesystem/boot/controller/thermal/power/BMC error or recovery loss
Do not Locate, remove a second member, force online, rebuild or reboot automatically
agent_execution_scope: Capture full array/member/slot and LED baseline
Record operator removal timestamp and monitor controller degraded/member status
Collect complete OS, BMC, health and physical observation evidence
Do not manipulate hardware, create recovery actions or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve disposable targets, fault, LED and recovery contract
Provide qualified operator and own any array/data recovery
Review real failed-state/LED evidence and separately decide recovery and verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Locate targets an indicator but does not create a member failure or prove RAID degradation; assumed controller/enclosure/slot values are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved controller workflow to create and verify isolated RAID1, then capture complete degraded/member-failed state and logs around one operator removal; do not issue an LED-control command as stimulus.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVMe insertion, RAID1 creation, one-member unplug, RAID-fail LED check and source 10/5 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the removal as a controlled one-member fault with immutable healthy and degraded snapshots and a separately authorized recovery stage.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact target/data safeguards and authoritative controller fault evidence while preserving the physical LED test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation observes the real fault but cannot substitute a Locate command or physical operator action.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Controllers may initiate copyback/rebuild on reinsertion; leaving recovery outside this step prevents uncontrolled writes and ambiguous final state.

project_override_considerations: If controller policy marks a removed member as missing rather than failed, the approved expected state and LED mapping must explicitly cover that terminology.
expected_evidence: Critical approval and RAID-fail LED/fault procedure
Disposable member serial-slot-controller map and healthy initialized RAID1 baseline
Array creation output and exact removal timestamp/operator record
Physical fail-LED photos/timing plus controller degraded/member-failed state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently specifies RAID1 creation, one-member removal and fail LED. DeepSeek's Locate shortcut is incomplete coverage rather than source ambiguity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Disposable targets, operator and recovery plan are supplyable fault-test prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Replaces a Locate proxy with a true isolated RAID1 member-failure state, exact physical mapping and separately governed recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: A fail LED is meaningful only when the controller actually transitions a known member and virtual disk into the documented fault/degraded states. An indicator-control command bypasses that diagnostic path, while uncontrolled reinsertion may immediately start rebuild; therefore the test needs a real single-member removal, controller proof and a deliberate stop before recovery.
